experiences.name: Sagrada Família Guided Tour
experiences.description: Explore Gaudí's iconic unfinished basilica with a skip-the-line guided tour. Marvel at the intricate facades, stunning stained glass interiors, and climb the towers for panoramic city views. A must-see masterpiece of modernist architecture.

experiences.name: Gothic Quarter Walking Tour
experiences.description: Wander through Barcelona's medieval Gothic Quarter, discovering Roman ruins, the Barcelona Cathedral, hidden plazas, and centuries-old narrow alleyways. Join a guided walking tour to uncover the rich layered history embedded in every stone.

experiences.name: Park Güell & Gràcia Neighborhood Exploration
experiences.description: Visit Gaudí's whimsical Park Güell with its mosaic terraces, gingerbread gatehouses, and sweeping city views. Afterward, stroll through the bohemian Gràcia neighborhood to admire modernist buildings and enjoy tapas at a local bar.

experiences.name: Clubbing on Passeig Marítim
experiences.description: Experience Barcelona's legendary nightlife along the beachfront strip. Visit iconic clubs like Pacha or Opium, where world-class DJs spin until dawn. Pre-drinks at a beach bar are recommended before hitting the clubs, which peak after midnight.

experiences.name: El Born Cocktail Bar Crawl
experiences.description: Explore the trendy El Born neighborhood's vibrant bar scene, hopping between craft cocktail bars, speakeasies, and rooftop terraces. The area blends stunning 19th-century architecture with a buzzing after-dark atmosphere perfect for architecture lovers who also enjoy nightlife.
